english.title: Unauthorised declaration of local connection - false statement - elections
english.standardoffencewording:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..) made a

namely **(..SPECIFY FALSIFICATION..)
english.legislation: Contrary to section 62(1)(a) of the Representation of the People Act 1983.

english.notes:
(i) For "service declarations" see Section 16 of the 1983 Act - Contents of service declarations.
(ii) Where the declaration is available only for local government elections the reference to a legal incapacity to vote in Section 62 (i)(a)(ii) refers to a legal incapacity to vote at local government elections
(iii) This offence has been inserted by paragraph 17 of Schedule 1 to the Representation of the People Act 2000.
(iv) See also offence wordings H2674, H2675, H2676, H2678, H2679, H2680, H2681, H2682 and H2683.

other.penalty:
SUMMARY: A fine not exceeding level five on the standard scale.

Time limit for prosecutions:
Complex - see legislation

On the 12th March 2015 the limit on fines imposed by a Magistrates’ court was removed – as such, the potential fine on summary conviction in relation to an offence committed after this date is unlimited.
